Bihar Teacher Recruitment Exam Application Process Postponed

The application process for the Bihar Teacher Recruitment Examination (TRE-4) has been postponed. The decision to halt the application process was made due to unspecified reasons. The TRE-4 exam was scheduled to begin accepting applications from September 1. Further details regarding the new application dates have not yet been released.
